---- MODULE W4Od13m8p5t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Customers, Slots
VARIABLES bankLock, slotLock, dispensed, stock

None == "none"

TypeInv ==
    /\ bankLock \in Customers \cup {None}
    /\ slotLock \in [Slots -> Customers \cup {None}]
    /\ dispensed \in SUBSET Slots
    /\ stock \in [Slots -> 0..1]

\* Coarse lock: a customer grabs the machine-bank lock when it is free.
GrabBank ==
    /\ bankLock = None
    /\ \E c \in Customers : bankLock' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotLock, dispensed, stock>>

\* Fine lock: the bank-lock holder claims a free slot lock (hierarchical order).
GrabSlot ==
    /\ bankLock # None
    /\ \E s \in Slots :
         /\ slotLock[s] = None
         /\ slotLock' = [slotLock EXCEPT ![s] = bankLock]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bankLock, dispensed, stock>>

\* The irreversible dispense: fires at most once per slot, only while the customer
\* holds both the bank lock and that slot's fine lock and the slot still has stock.
Dispense ==
    /\ \E s \in Slots :
         /\ bankLock # None
         /\ slotLock[s] = bankLock
         /\ stock[s] = 1
         /\ s \notin dispensed
         /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![s] = 0]
         /\ dispensed' = dispensed \cup {s}
         /\ slotLock' = [slotLock EXCEPT ![s] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bankLock>>

\* The customer releases the coarse lock once it holds no fine locks.
ReleaseBank ==
    /\ bankLock # None
    /\ \A s \in Slots : slotLock[s] # bankLock
    /\ bankLock' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotLock, dispensed, stock>>

\* The holder may be slow, dwelling on its locks without acting; it never fails.
Dwell ==
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bankLock, slotLock, dispensed, stock>>

Next == GrabBank \/ GrabSlot \/ Dispense \/ ReleaseBank \/ Dwell

vars == <<bankLock, slotLock, dispensed, stock>>
Init ==
    /\ bankLock = None
    /\ slotLock = [s \in Slots |-> None]
    /\ dispensed = {}
    /\ stock = [s \in Slots |-> 1]

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The dispense is irreversible and happens at most once: a slot is marked
\* dispensed exactly when its stock has been drawn to zero, so no slot is ever
\* vended twice.
DispenseIrreversible ==
    \A s \in Slots : (s \in dispensed) <=> (stock[s] = 0)
====
nl:
A vending machine network protects each dispense with a two-level hierarchical lock. To vend, a customer must first grab the coarse machine-bank lock, and only then may it claim the fine lock on an individual slot, always coarse-before-fine. The dispense itself is the irreversible action: while the customer holds both the bank lock and that slot's fine lock, and the slot still has its single unit of stock, the machine vends it -- drawing the stock to zero, marking the slot dispensed, and releasing the fine lock. A slot that has already been dispensed can never be vended again. The customer releases the coarse lock once it holds no fine locks. A customer may be slow, dwelling on its locks without acting, but it never fails outright. The concern is that each slot's irreversible vend happens at most once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: in every reachable state a slot is marked dispensed exactly when its stock has been drawn to zero, so no slot is ever vended more than once.

---- MODULE W4Od15m1p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers
CONSTANTS N, Instances, MaxGen, MaxMatched
VARIABLES tokenPos, cleared, poolOwner, matched, gen

None == "none"

Engines == 0..(N - 1)

TypeInv ==
    /\ tokenPos \in Engines
    /\ cleared \in [Engines -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ poolOwner \in Instances \cup {None}
    /\ matched \in 0..MaxMatched
    /\ gen \in 0..MaxGen

\* One of two auction instances seizes the shared order pool, opening a new
\* auction generation.
AcquirePool ==
    /\ poolOwner = None
    /\ gen < MaxGen
    /\ \E i \in Instances :
         /\ poolOwner' = i
         /\ gen' = gen + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenPos, cleared, matched>>

\* Only while an instance owns the pool may the current token holder be granted
\* clearance to match an order.
GrantClearance ==
    /\ poolOwner # None
    /\ ~cleared[tokenPos]
    /\ cleared' = [cleared EXCEPT ![tokenPos] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenPos, poolOwner, matched, gen>>

\* The cleared token holder commits one matched trade, consuming its clearance.
Commit ==
    /\ cleared[tokenPos]
    /\ matched < MaxMatched
    /\ matched' = matched + 1
    /\ cleared' = [cleared EXCEPT ![tokenPos] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenPos, poolOwner, gen>>

\* The write token advances around the ring; it may pass only when the current
\* holder is not mid-clearance.
PassToken ==
    /\ ~cleared[tokenPos]
    /\ tokenPos' = (tokenPos + 1) % N
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cleared, poolOwner, matched, gen>>

\* An instance releases the pool once no engine holds clearance.
ReleasePool ==
    /\ poolOwner # None
    /\ \A e \in Engines : ~cleared[e]
    /\ poolOwner' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenPos, cleared, matched, gen>>

\* The token holder may relinquish its clearance without matching.
CancelClearance ==
    /\ cleared[tokenPos]
    /\ cleared' = [cleared EXCEPT ![tokenPos] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenPos, poolOwner, matched, gen>>

Next == AcquirePool \/ GrantClearance \/ Commit \/ PassToken \/ ReleasePool
        \/ CancelClearance

vars == <<tokenPos, cleared, poolOwner, matched, gen>>
Init ==
    /\ tokenPos = 0
    /\ cleared = [e \in Engines |-> FALSE]
    /\ poolOwner = None
    /\ matched = 0
    /\ gen = 0

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No unauthorized or stale matching: any engine holding clearance to match is the
\* current token holder and does so under an instance that actually owns the pool.
OnlyHolderCleared ==
    \A e \in Engines :
        cleared[e] => (e = tokenPos /\ poolOwner # None)
====

CONSTANTS
    N = 3
    Instances = {inst1, inst2}
    MaxGen = 2
    MaxMatched = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnlyHolderCleared
nl:
A stock exchange opening auction is run by a ring of matching engines that serialize order matching with a single write token: only the engine currently holding the token may match a trade. Two independent auction instances share one order pool, so an instance must first seize the pool -- which opens a new auction generation -- before any matching can happen. While an instance owns the pool, the current token holder can be granted a clearance to match, and when it commits it consumes that clearance and records one matched trade. The token advances around the ring, but only when the current holder is not in the middle of a cleared match, so clearance never travels ahead of the token. The holder may also relinquish its clearance without matching. An instance releases the pool only once no engine holds any clearance. The concern is that no engine other than the legitimate token holder -- and only under an instance that actually owns the pool -- may ever be authorized to match, so stale or unauthorized matches are impossible.
SAFETY PROPERTY: in every reachable state any engine holding a clearance to match is the current token holder and operates under an instance that genuinely owns the pool.
